title: Why You've Stopped Trusting Yourself (And How to Start Again)

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到钱，而不仅仅是用时间换金钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: What if the person you've stopped trusting is yourself?
sentences.zh: 如果那个你不再信任的人其实是你自己呢？

sentences.en: Not because you're weak, not because you're incapable, but because somewhere along the way, someone or something taught you that your instincts couldn't be trusted.
sentences.zh: 不是因为你软弱，也不是因为你无能，而是因为在成长的某个阶段，有人或某件事让你觉得自己的直觉不可信。

sentences.en: Maybe it was burnout.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为职业倦怠。

sentences.en: Maybe it was an unhealthy relationship.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为一段不健康的关系。

sentences.en: Maybe years of criticism drowned out your own voice.
sentences.zh: 也许是多年的批评淹没了你自己的声音。

sentences.en: Today, I want to explore what it really means to begin to trust yourself again.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想探讨一下重新开始信任自己到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Welcome to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“内在工作”。

sentences.en: This week in the main episode, Psychology Actually, I'm chatting with Dr. Ellie all about her time on the traitors and what trust is.
sentences.zh: 本周在主节目《心理学其实》中，我将与艾莉博士畅谈她参加《叛徒》节目的经历，以及什么是信任。

sentences.en: But I thought we'd take a little look in Inner Work about what trusting yourself looks like,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们可以在“内在工作”中稍微探讨一下信任自己是什么样子的，

sentences.en: which can be a very different ballgame than trusting or distrusting others, mainly because we are always with ourselves and that can make life quite tricky.
sentences.zh: 这与信任或不信任他人完全不同，主要是因为我们总是与自己相处，这会让生活变得相当棘手。

sentences.en: One of my colleagues and psychologist trainers once said, I think there's often a very good and important reason why this shows up for you, why this shows up for us.
sentences.zh: 我的一位同事兼心理学培训师曾说：“我认为这种情况之所以出现在你身上，出现在我们身上，往往有一个非常充分且重要的理由。”

sentences.en: And that is certainly the case when it comes to feeling like you can't trust your own judgment.
sentences.zh: 当我们觉得无法相信自己的判断时，情况确实如此。

sentences.en: So let's take a look.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来看看吧。

sentences.en: So often when I'm working with adults who might report to me that they've had, you know, anxiety or depression showing up for them at different periods of their life, on and off,
sentences.zh: 当我与那些向我报告说他们在人生不同阶段断断续续出现焦虑或抑郁的成年人工作时，

sentences.en: on and off.
sentences.zh: 断断续续的。

sentences.en: And they don't really know why they'll be like, well, you know, I've had a pretty good upbringing.
sentences.zh: 他们真的不知道为什么，他们会说，嗯，你知道，我的成长环境还不错。

sentences.en: My parents are all right.
sentences.zh: 我的父母都挺好的。

sentences.en: You know, I came from a happy home.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我来自一个幸福的家庭。

sentences.en: So, I don't know, it's just me, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道，这只是我自己的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I'm the problem, it's me.
sentences.zh: 就像，我是那个问题所在，是我。

sentences.en: And then over time, as we begin to take a little bit of a look about actually what their early experiences were like,
sentences.zh: 然后随着时间的推移，当我们开始稍微审视一下他们早年的经历时，

sentences.en: we can often begin to piece together that actually maybe things in their development, their early years, their first 18 years,
sentences.zh: 我们往往可以开始拼凑出，实际上，也许他们在发展过程中，在早年，在最初的18年里，

sentences.en: were not as calm, were not as consistent, were not as predictable, and were not as safe as they deserved for them to be.
sentences.zh: 并不像他们理应得到的那样平静、稳定、可预测和安全。

sentences.en: Not because they're a queen, not because they're a king, not because they're a princess, but because all of us, you know,
sentences.zh: 不是因为他们是女王，不是因为他们是国王，不是因为他们是公主，而是因为我们所有人，你知道，

sentences.en: regardless of who we are, when we're born, when we grow, when we develop, we deserve to have a safe, good enough childhood
sentences.zh: 无论我们是谁，无论我们何时出生，何时成长，何时发展，我们都理应拥有一个安全、足够好的童年，

sentences.en: where we are loved, where we are protected, where we are fed, where we are clothed, where there's consistency, where there's boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在那里我们被爱、被保护、有饭吃、有衣穿、有稳定性、有界限。

sentences.en: And really, that might sound like very simple things that humans need, but that is really the bare bones about what helps us to thrive.
sentences.zh: 真的，这听起来可能是人类所需的最简单的事情，但这些确实是我们茁壮成长的基础。

sentences.en: So, when we look back on people's lives sometimes, and they're like, well, you know, my parents were in a domestically violent relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们回顾人们的生活时，有时他们会说，嗯，你知道，我的父母处于家庭暴力关系中。

sentences.en: One of my parents was low in mood, depressed, and was thinking about suicide at one stage.
sentences.zh: 我的一位家长情绪低落、抑郁，甚至一度想过自杀。

sentences.en: You know, maybe someone in the household went to prison, or, you know, maybe we were hit as children, and I was really scared for my own safety, or the safety of my siblings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许家里有人坐过牢，或者，你知道，也许我们小时候被打过，我真的很担心自己的安全，或者我兄弟姐妹的安全。

sentences.en: Or maybe just, you know, that sense that your family didn't feel the same as other people's families.
sentences.zh: 或者也许只是，你知道，那种觉得你的家庭与别人的家庭感觉不一样的感觉。

sentences.en: We begin to piece together a little bit of a presentation, which might then explain why trusting ourselves and trusting other people might feel problematic.
sentences.zh: 我们开始拼凑出一点点表现，这或许能解释为什么信任自己和信任他人会感觉有问题。

sentences.en: Because if we've always been told bad things about ourselves, or that, you know, we haven't been raised in a way that makes us think we can achieve,
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们总是被告知关于自己的坏话，或者，你知道，我们没有以一种让我们认为自己能成功的方式被抚养长大，

sentences.en: and we can produce an outcome that is something we're striving for, and that it's okay for us to strive for things,
sentences.zh: 并且我们可以产生我们所追求的结果，而且我们追求事物是可以的，

sentences.en: then we're very quickly going to begin to undermine our own hopes, our own dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 那么我们很快就会开始破坏自己的希望，自己的梦想。

sentences.en: I really like the book by Simon Squibb called What's Your Dream?
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢西蒙·斯奎布写的书《你的梦想是什么？》

sentences.en: Because it really can get us to think, right, if I took all of the expectations, all of the self-limitations off myself,
sentences.zh: 因为它真的能让我们思考，对，如果我卸下所有的期望，所有的自我限制，

sentences.en: myself, and just allowed myself to think, what would genuinely light me up, you know?
sentences.zh: 卸下这些，只允许自己思考，什么才是真正能点亮我的东西，你知道吗？

sentences.en: How could I trust myself to back myself, to get me where I would want to be, if I took away all of that external noise, or maybe sometimes even that internal noise?
sentences.zh: 如果我排除了所有外部噪音，甚至有时是内部噪音，我该如何信任自己去支持自己，让我到达我想去的地方？

sentences.en: And I love it, his philosophy, where he's like, you know, I'm going to give you this money to get you started, to get you over this first hurdle, you know?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他的哲学，他说，你知道，我要给你这笔钱让你开始，让你跨过这第一道障碍，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Because then, you know, who are we kidding?
sentences.zh: 因为那样的话，你知道，我们在骗谁呢？

sentences.en: If we're not getting our dreams, if we're not backing ourselves, because we've been saying,
sentences.zh: 如果我们没有实现梦想，如果我们没有支持自己，因为我们一直在说，

sentences.en: this reason why I can't do it, and then that reason is taken away, then I think, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是我不能做到的原因，然后那个原因被消除了，那么我想，你知道，

sentences.en: we do then have to do the inner work, we have to be curious to think about why we are getting in our own way,
sentences.zh: 我们确实必须做内在工作，我们必须好奇地思考为什么我们在阻碍自己，

sentences.en: and it might be an element of self-preservation, which is okay, you know, because doing new things
sentences.zh: 这可能是一种自我保护的因素，这没关系，你知道，因为做新事物

sentences.en: does feel a bit scary, does feel a bit risky, but I think it is just holding it gently with curiosity, and having a look at it, and thinking, what is that about?
sentences.zh: 确实感觉有点可怕，确实感觉有点冒险，但我认为只是带着好奇心温和地对待它，看看它，思考一下，这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Is that genuinely true, or is this a decision that I'm making based on old information, or, you know, information that I'm imagining might come to pass in the future?
sentences.zh: 这是真的吗，还是我基于旧信息，或者，你知道，我想象未来可能会发生的信息所做的决定？

sentences.en: So, just be watchful.
sentences.zh: 所以，保持警惕。

sentences.en: If you're getting in your own way, or if it feels like, you know, other people will say things, just take a look, see what you think.
sentences.zh: 如果你在阻碍自己，或者如果感觉，你知道，别人会说些什么，只需看一看，看看你怎么想。

sentences.en: I would love to know what you do think.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你是怎么想的。

sentences.en: What is this bringing up for you?
sentences.zh: 这给你带来了什么？

sentences.en: What is your dream?
sentences.zh: 你的梦想是什么？

sentences.en: Are you able to trust yourself with it, so that you can achieve?
sentences.zh: 你能够信任自己去实现它吗？

sentences.en: I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的到来。

sentences.en: The next episode of Inner Work is at 8pm on Wednesday, and if you've enjoyed this episode, I think you'll really like this one on screen, which is about stopping, waiting to be
sentences.zh: 下一集“内在工作”将于周三晚上8点播出，如果你喜欢这一集，我想你会非常喜欢屏幕上的这一集，它是关于停止等待被

sentences.en: chosen, and choosing yourself, controlling your own destiny.
sentences.zh: 选择，而是选择你自己，掌控你自己的命运。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I'll see you soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.zh: 六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。
